svg.title: Fetal omphalocele
svg.desc: AI-generated, vector-traced teaching illustration of the modeled mid-trimester case. The fetal anterior abdominal wall opens at the midline. Bowel extends through the opening into a membrane-covered sac. The umbilical cord attaches to the apex of the sac.

g.text: AI-generated teaching illustration · Modeled mid-trimester transverse section
